import.001: Import file abhi available nahi hai.
import.002: Pehle setup ka sawal mukammal karein — file setup ke shuru mein ("Purana data" option) ya catalog ke marhale mein bhej sakte hain.
import.003: Pehle jo chal raha hai woh mukammal karein (ya "cancel" likhein), phir file bhejein.
import.004: Sirf Excel file (.xlsx) chalti hai — apni file ko "Save as → Excel Workbook (.xlsx)" karke dobara bhejein. Template ke liye "import" likhein.
import.005: File download nahi ho saki — dobara bhej dein.
import.006: File 5 MB se badi hai — usay do hisson mein baant kar bhejein.
import.007: File khul nahi saki — Excel (.xlsx) honi chahiye. Template ke liye "import" likhein.
import.008: Is file mein "Customers" ya "Catalog" naam ki sheet nahi mili. Template ya export wali file istemal karein — "import" likhein.

import.018:
📥 Purana data laayein (customers / products)

1️⃣ Neeche se file chunein aur download karein — us mein "Guide" naam ki sheet hai jo batati hai kya kahan likhna hai
2️⃣ Apne purane system ya copy se data us mein paste karein (headings na badlein)
3️⃣ File isi chat mein wapas bhej dein — main check kar ke summary dikhaunga, aap YES kahenge tab hi save hoga

Pehle se export ki hui file ("export all") bhi bhej sakte hain. Sirf .xlsx chalega. Ghalti ho to "undo".
